texts.text: It's Teddy. I said I pay what I owe. A woman has been asking around about Halloran. I gave her your name. She'll be at the bar.
You photographed a ledger. I would like to see those pages. I'm at the bar tonight. I.P.

h_offer.speaker: Mr. Halloran
h_offer.text: You do what you're told and you don't make a show of it. I have steadier work for someone like that. Some nights a friend of the house sits at your table. He wins. You don't ask whose money it is. Each time, there's an envelope.

d_idle.speaker: Mara
d_idle.text: Sit down if you're playing. Minimum is ten.

g_vip.speaker: Security
g_vip.text: VIP room. Members, and staff with a gold card. You're neither.

g_card.speaker: Security
g_card.text: Gold card. Fine. The room is closed for a refit. Come back another night.

b_drinks.speaker: Bartender
b_drinks.text: Drinks are free while you're playing. Ever wonder why?

r_tip.speaker: A regular
r_tip.text: Thirty years I've played this floor. Want to know something? The machines by the door pay. They want people walking in to see somebody winning. Back here, they're tight as a drum. I play here anyway. Habit.

r_again.speaker: A regular
r_again.text: By the door, kid. I told you. Loose by the door, tight in the back.

l_idle.text: A ledger on the pit stand. Not your business. Not yet.

l_look.text: The pit ledger, left open. Payout lines for hands that were never dealt, each one initialled D.H. Halloran is ten feet away.

l_got.text: Eleven pages on your phone. Halloran hasn't looked up. You think.

l_taken.text: The ledger is where you found it. The pictures are in your pocket.
